name: Peter is named among the Twelve
summary: Simon, whom Jesus renames Peter, is listed first among the twelve apostles Jesus chooses.

name: Andrew is named among the Twelve
summary: Peter's brother is named among the twelve apostles.

name: James, son of Zebedee is named among the Twelve
summary: James, the son of Zebedee and brother of John, is named among the twelve apostles.

name: John, son of Zebedee is named among the Twelve
summary: John, the son of Zebedee and brother of James, is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Philip is named among the Twelve
summary: Philip is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Bartholomew is named among the Twelve
summary: Bartholomew is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Thomas is named among the Twelve
summary: Thomas is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Matthew is named among the Twelve
summary: Matthew the tax collector is named among the twelve apostles.

name: James, son of Alphaeus is named among the Twelve
summary: James, the son of Alphaeus, is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Thaddaeus is named among the Twelve
summary: Thaddaeus is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Simon the Zealot is named among the Twelve
summary: Simon the Zealot is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Judas Iscariot is named among the Twelve
summary: Judas Iscariot is named last among the twelve apostles, with a note that he would betray Jesus.

name: Jacob blesses Reuben
summary: Jacob blesses Reuben, his firstborn, but withholds the honor of that birthright.

name: Jacob blesses Simeon
summary: Jacob blesses Simeon, rebuking him for violence.

name: Jacob blesses Levi
summary: Jacob blesses Levi, rebuking him for violence alongside Simeon.

name: Jacob blesses Judah
summary: Jacob blesses Judah with royal leadership over his brothers.

name: Jacob blesses Zebulun
summary: Jacob blesses Zebulun to dwell by the seashore.

name: Jacob blesses Issachar
summary: Jacob blesses Issachar, comparing him to a strong donkey.

name: Jacob blesses Dan
summary: Jacob blesses Dan, comparing him to a serpent in the road.

name: Jacob blesses Gad
summary: Jacob blesses Gad, comparing him to a raiding band that strikes back.

name: Jacob blesses Asher
summary: Jacob blesses Asher with rich food.

name: Jacob blesses Naphtali
summary: Jacob blesses Naphtali, comparing him to a doe set free.

name: Jacob blesses Joseph
summary: Jacob blesses Joseph abundantly as his favored son.

name: Jacob blesses Benjamin
summary: Jacob blesses Benjamin, comparing him to a ravenous wolf.

name: Paul calls believers to offer their lives as a living sacrifice
summary: Paul urges believers to present their bodies as a living sacrifice and be transformed by the renewing of their minds rather than conformed to the world.

name: Paul describes the body of Christ with different gifts
summary: Paul compares believers to one body with many members, each given different gifts such as prophecy, service, teaching, and leadership.

name: Paul instructs believers to love genuinely and overcome evil with good
summary: Paul calls believers to let love be genuine, bless those who persecute them, live at peace with everyone, and overcome evil with good.

name: Paul describes different spiritual gifts from the same Spirit
summary: Paul explains that believers receive different spiritual gifts, but the same Spirit gives all of them for the common good.

name: Paul compares the church to one body with many parts
summary: Paul compares the church to a human body, where the foot, hand, eye, and ear each play a different but necessary part.

name: Paul teaches that every part of the body is needed and honored
summary: Paul teaches that no part of the body can say it does not need the others, since God arranged each part exactly as he chose.
